reasoning_content:
A cgroup issue in this environment for some containers. Let me investigate. Some containers started (db, reverse-proxy) but valhalla failed with cgroup threaded mode. This is an environment issue. Let's check which containers are running.

The error is about cgroupv2 threaded mode. Let me check.

action.command: cd /workspace && docker ps -a --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}'; echo "---cgroup---"; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.controllers 2>/dev/null; ls /sys/fs/cgroup/ | head; cat /proc/self/cgroup

tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && docker ps -a --format 'table {{.Names}}\\t{{.Status}}'; echo \"---cgroup---\"; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.controllers 2>/dev/null; ls /sys/fs/cgroup/ | head; cat /proc/self/cgroup", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Inspect container and cgroup state"}
